query:
SELECT p.total::numeric(14, 2) AS "total!: Decimal",
               COALESCE(
                   (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM wallet_movements
                    WHERE purchase_id = p.id AND kind = 'purchase_payment'),
                   0
               )::numeric(14, 2) AS "paid_upfront!: Decimal"
        FROM purchases p
        WHERE p.id = $1
